projects.title: Nova WM
projects.description: Modern tiling window manager built in Rust for high-performance window management on Linux.
projects.longDescription: Nova WM is a tiling window manager written in Rust, designed for efficiency and customization. It provides a fast window management experience with minimal resource usage. Features include dynamic tiling layouts, a keyboard-driven workflow, and extensive configuration options. Built with memory safety and performance in mind, leveraging Rust's zero-cost abstractions to deliver a compositor that's both reliable and quick.

projects.title: Monoshell
projects.description: Monochromatic desktop shell built with QML for a modern Linux workflow.
projects.longDescription: Monoshell is a monochromatic desktop rice built mostly in QML. It replaces every standard desktop shell component with custom-built alternatives: a status bar with workspaces, a clock popup, and OSD toasts; a notification sidebar with a card list, media player, and toggle controls; a full-screen app launcher with live search and keyboard navigation; a power menu; and a native lockscreen with a widget grid showing clock, calendar, media, weather, battery, and uptime. Every component follows a strict monochromatic design language.

projects.title: Dashboard Portfolio
projects.description: Modern, dashboard-style portfolio template built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, and shadcn/ui for showcasing projects and experience.
projects.longDescription: A fully customizable portfolio template featuring a clean dashboard-style interface with JSON-driven content management. Built with modern web technologies including Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components. Features include dark/light mode, responsive design, blog support with markdown rendering, and a development-only blog maker tool. All content is managed through organized JSON files, making it easy to customize without touching code.

projects.title: task-cli
projects.description: CLI automation tool for a popular issue tracker with comprehensive GraphQL API integration.
projects.longDescription: A high-performance command-line interface for an issue tracker that streamlines project management workflows. Built with Python and GraphQL, featuring robust CI/CD pipelines, semantic versioning, and comprehensive test coverage. Achieves sub-2-second response times for complex queries and supports all major operations including issue management, team coordination, and project tracking.

projects.title: Data Platform Database Layer
projects.description: Scalable database infrastructure for enterprise data management, handling 1M+ records for client integration.
projects.longDescription: Built the foundational database layer for an enterprise data platform. The system enables seamless integration of new clients into the company's project ecosystem by providing a robust, scalable data model that handles complex hierarchical relationships and supports rapid client onboarding with zero downtime.

projects.title: Data Platform REST API
projects.description: High-performance RESTful API for enterprise data management with comprehensive endpoints and real-time data access.
projects.longDescription: Developed a production-grade FastAPI service that exposes the data platform through a clean, well-documented REST interface. Implements advanced features including query optimization, caching strategies, authentication, and rate limiting. Supports complex filtering, pagination, and bulk operations while maintaining sub-100ms response times for standard queries.

projects.title: Data Platform UI
projects.description: Modern TypeScript frontend for the enterprise data platform with intuitive data visualization and management.
projects.longDescription: Built a comprehensive web application for managing and visualizing platform data. Features include interactive dashboards, real-time updates, advanced filtering, and bulk operations. Implemented with React, TypeScript, and modern state management, providing a seamless user experience for complex data operations. Includes comprehensive testing, CI/CD integration, and Docker containerization.

projects.title: ThemeValley
projects.description: Linux rice featuring 5 stunning themes (Space, Nature, Ocean, Sakura, Code-RED) for a modern window manager.
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive desktop configuration with meticulously crafted themes that transform the Linux desktop experience. Each theme includes custom bar configurations, color schemes, wallpapers, and system integrations. Gained traction in the Linux community, demonstrating strong appreciation for the aesthetic and functional design.

projects.title: VideoLingo
projects.description: AI-powered video translator with voice cloning capabilities.
projects.longDescription: An early Python project that helped with learning the language and AI integration. Takes a video, clones the speaker's voice, and recreates the video in a different language. Despite being an early project with legacy code, it gained community interest, demonstrating the value of the concept. Now archived as a learning milestone.

projects.title: RetroTopia
projects.description: Desktop rice with a beautiful retro theme aesthetic for Linux enthusiasts.
projects.longDescription: A polished desktop configuration featuring a warm, retro color scheme. Includes custom shell scripts, CSS styling, and carefully curated system integrations that create a cohesive and visually appealing desktop environment. Designed for developers who appreciate a retro aesthetic while maintaining modern functionality.
